title: The activate API refuses bad requests with 400 and already-active parts as failed
custom_preconds: Admin token from DevTools; X-Location-ID set. Active part A.
custom_steps:
1. PATCH /api/inventory/parts/status with no partIds
  2. Send 201 partIds
  3. Send partIds ["abc"]
  4. Send status "paused"
  5. Send a 256-character note
  6. Send {"partIds":["<A>"],"status":"active"}
  7. Repeat step 6
custom_expected:
1. 400
  2. 400
  3. 400
  4. 400
  5. 400 "A note cannot be longer than 255 characters."
  6. 200 with A in failed: "Part is already in that state."
  7. 200 with updated: []; nothing changes
